messages:
support-bot: :rotating_light: Customer escalation: multiple customers reporting sudden 5xx and timeouts after today's 06:00 deploy. High volume from hosted inference endpoints. Topline: ~12% error rate on /v1/generate for a subset of traffic.
anya: oncall here — thanks. Which rollout happened at 06:00? can you paste the deploy id and any alert links?
support-bot: Deploy id: deploy-2026-03-17-06. Alerts: https://ops.redwood/alerts/ERR-5XX-20260317 (summary + graphs). Customers include finapp-prod and searchly-prod.
jeff: saw the alert spike. Preliminary: lots of 502/504s from api-gateway -> model-proxy. Logs show downstream connection resets and also a handful of 500s with "route selection failed".
marta: we rolled the new proxy routing change (route-selection v2) to 30% to test new header handling. It was behind flag `route_selector_v2=true` (service: api-gateway).
ops_lead: suspects header rewrite. We've had one bug before where proxy truncates long `X-Routing-Tag` values and backend returns 500. Can someone confirm header lengths in recent requests?
jeff: grabbing logs now. snippets: ```
[2026-03-17T06:02:13Z] api-gateway->proxy id=abc123 upstream="model-proxy:8080" status=502 err="connection reset by peer"
[2026-03-17T06:02:14Z] model-proxy ERROR route_selection: header_key='X-Routing-Tag' value='tenant-prod-very-long-tag-...'(truncated) => no matching route
[2026-03-17T06:02:14Z] model-proxy panic: runtime error: index out of range
```
support-bot: Customers also report increased latency before error, and some billing spikes due to retries. One customer sent curl repro: `curl -v -H "X-Routing-Tag: tenant-prod-very-long-routing-tag-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX" https://api.redwood/v1/generate` -> 500 consistently.
anya: OK immediate mitigation: take the route_selector_v2 flag back off to stop new traffic to the code path. Who can flip?
marta: I can flip the flag via console. Setting `route_selector_v2=false` for production now.
marta: :white_check_mark: flag toggle submitted. API shows change in config; effect should be within ~30s.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Config change applied: route_selector_v2=false at 2026-03-17T06:07:05Z by marta.
ops_lead: start a measured rollback of the proxy canary as well — scale down new proxy replica set. Command: `kubectl -n infra set image deploy/model-proxy model-proxy=registry/redwood/model-proxy:stable-20260228` then `kubectl rollout status deploy/model-proxy -w`.
jeff: running the image set now. Output: ```
deployment.apps/model-proxy image updated
Waiting for rollout to finish: 0 of 4 updated...
Rollout complete
```
ops_lead: good. After rollback I want to validate by hitting the same curl with long header.
support-bot: re-run customer curl test: `curl -H "X-Routing-Tag: tenant-prod-very-long-routing-tag-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX" https://api.redwood/v1/generate -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n"` -> 200 now.
anya: confirm metrics: error rate dropping from 12% to ~0.8% over last 5m. Graphs: https://ops.redwood/alerts/ERR-5XX-20260317?range=5m
marta: thanks all. jeff, can you add a defensive check in the proxy to avoid truncating/panic on header values? Also add a feature gate so we can replay longer header cases in staging.
jeff: will open PR after triage. Root cause looks like a string-slice bug when handling long header tokens in route-selector v2. I'll add length guards + unit tests.
ops_lead: create an incident ticket and customer-facing postmortem. For now we should reach out to affected customers with apology + note: rollback done, SDKs unaffected, ask if they saw retries causing billing.
support-bot: already created ticket INC-20260317-5XX and sent templated message to customers.
anya: nice fast reaction. Postmortem leads: jeff (eng-runtime) and marta (product). Keep this thread updated with PR/CL numbers and timeline. :thumbsup:
